title: Digital Receipt NFT
tagline: A Dapp to issue receipts as NFT and reduce paper receipts.
description:
A Dapp to issue receipts as NFT and reduce paper receipts.
 
Problem with Paper receipt:
- It is wasteful
- It causes trees to be cut down
- Most of the time, it is thrown in the trash
- It is difficult to keep track of paper receipts and know how much you spent for the day

How it works:
- User can issue digital receipt as an NFT to someone for  proof of purchase or service
- User can view all their digital receipts on a dashboard
- Digital receipt’s metadata cannot be change

Contacts:
- Filecoin Hyperspace => 0xB2e0621213dD162a1BE0eAf42452306EF2Af66dc
how_its_made:
I built the Dapp with Vue and use Chakra UI for styling.  I built the contract with Hardhat and Remix.  I deploy my contracts on the Filecoin Hyperspace.

I used the following technologies:
- FEVM - I deployed the contract on Filecoin Hyperspace Testnet
- IPFS - Receipt data are stored on IPFS using Pinata
